compiled_state.title: As a CI workflow, I mirror tracker defenses to PR comments at PR-open before the first review dispatch
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Description

**What**: Add a mirror-defenses-to-pr workflow step in ci.yml that runs as a needs: dependency before llm-review. The step idempotently posts all tracker defenses for the PR's tickets as PR comments. GitHubPRDefenseStore.load() falls through to TrackerDefenseStore if the mirror has not run.
**Why**: SC3 ordering contract. Without this, the first CI review on a PR loads an empty PR-side defense store and re-raises previously defended findings.
**Scope**:
  IN:
  - ci.yml has mirror-defenses-to-pr step as needs: predecessor of llm-review
  - Step is idempotent (re-running produces same comment set, no duplicates)
  - Soft fallback in GitHubPRDefenseStore.load() reads from TrackerDefenseStore if mirror hasn't run
  - Mirror batches comments with inter-batch delay to respect GitHub secondary rate limits
  OUT:
  - GitHubPRDefenseStore implementation (S12)

## Done Definitions

- When this story is complete, at PR open, all tracker defenses for the PR's tickets are mirrored as PR comments before the first llm-review dispatch
  ← Satisfies: "DefenseStore with split backends, shared loader/writer, ticket-binding integrity, and explicit ordering contract"
- Unit tests written and passing for all new or modified logic

## Considerations

- [Reliability] Mirror failure does not block llm-review (soft fallback covers it)

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
